import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem exists_central_involution_of_even_card
  {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
  (hG : ∀ H : Subgroup G, H.Normal)
  (heven : Even (Fintype.card G)) :
  ∃ x : G, x ≠ 1 ∧ x * x = 1 ∧ ∀ b : G, b * x = x * b := by
  have hdvd : 2 ∣ Fintype.card G := even_iff_two_dvd.mp heven
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card 2 hdvd
  have hx1 : x ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [orderOf_one] at hx
    revert hx
    decide
  have hx2 : x * x = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_two, ← hx, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
  refine ⟨x, hx1, hx2, fun b => ?_⟩
  have h_norm := hG (Subgroup.zpowers x)
  have h_conj : b * x * b⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers x :=
    Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem h_norm x (Subgroup.mem_zpowers x) b
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp h_conj
  have hx2_zpow : x ^ (2 : ℤ) = 1 := by
    rw [zpow_two, hx2]
  have hk_val : x ^ k = 1 ∨ x ^ k = x := by
    have hdiv : k = 2 * (k / 2) + k % 2 := (Int.ediv_add_emod k 2).symm
    have hmod : k % 2 = 0 ∨ k % 2 = 1 := by omega
    obtain h0 | h1 := hmod
    · left
      conv_lhs => rw [hdiv, h0, add_zero]
      rw [zpow_mul, hx2_zpow, one_zpow]
    · right
      conv_lhs => rw [hdiv, h1]
      rw [zpow_add, zpow_mul, hx2_zpow, one_zpow, one_mul, zpow_one]
  obtain h_one | h_x := hk_val
  · have h_bx : b * x * b⁻¹ = 1 := hk.symm.trans h_one
    have : x = 1 := by
      calc x = b⁻¹ * (b * x * b⁻¹) * b := by group
      _ = b⁻¹ * 1 * b := by rw [h_bx]
      _ = 1 := by group
    exact (hx1 this).elim
  · have h_eq : b * x * b⁻¹ = x := hk.symm.trans h_x
    calc b * x = (b * x * b⁻¹) * b := by group
    _ = x * b := by rw [h_eq]

  (heven : Even (Fintype.card G)) :
  ∃ x : G, x ≠ 1 ∧ x * x = 1 ∧ ∀ b : G, b * x = x * b := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime 2) := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
  have h2 : 2 ∣ Fintype.card G := even_iff_two_dvd.mp heven
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card 2 h2
  have hx1 : x ≠ 1 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [orderOf_one] at hx
    revert hx
    decide
  have hx2 : x * x = 1 := by
    have h_pow : x ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← hx, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
    rw [sq] at h_pow
    exact h_pow
  refine ⟨x, hx1, hx2, ?_⟩
  intro b
  have hnorm : (Subgroup.zpowers x).Normal := hG (Subgroup.zpowers x)
  have hmem : b * x * b⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers x :=
    hnorm.conj_mem x (Subgroup.mem_zpowers x) b
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hmem
  
  have h_pow2 : x ^ (2 : ℤ) = 1 := by
    have : (2 : ℤ) = 1 + 1 := rfl
    rw [this, zpow_add, zpow_one, hx2]
  have h_eq : x ^ k = x ^ (k % 2) := by
    have h_mod : k = 2 * (k / 2) + k % 2 := (Int.ediv_add_emod k 2).symm
    nth_rewrite 1 [h_mod]
    rw [zpow_add, zpow_mul, h_pow2, one_zpow, one_mul]
  have h_rem : k % 2 = 0 ∨ k % 2 = 1 := by
    have := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k (by decide : (2 : ℤ) > 0)
    have := Int.emod_nonneg k (by decide : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0)
    omega
  rcases h_rem with h0 | h1
  · exfalso
    have h_one : x ^ k = 1 := by rw [h_eq, h0, zpow_zero]
    rw [h_one] at hk
    have : x = 1 := by
      calc
        x = b⁻¹ * (b * x * b⁻¹) * b := by group
        _ = b⁻¹ * 1 * b := by rw [← hk]
        _ = 1 := by group
    exact hx1 this
  · have h_x : x ^ k = x := by rw [h_eq, h1, zpow_one]
    rw [h_x] at hk
    calc
      b * x = (b * x * b⁻¹) * b := by group
      _ = x * b := by rw [← hk]
